text: The authors state that their evaluations are confined to long-passage question answering and algorithmic coding, that they did not study human evaluators of varying capability (all QA subjects were experienced native English readers and all programming subjects experienced Python programmers, with 3-10 minute limits), and that they only collected binary correctness judgments, so it is worth studying whether other feedback forms are more robust to U-Sophistry.
title: Limitations: two task domains, skilled evaluators only, binary correctness feedback
